data.reason: The second review returned six more findings. F1, high: a check run by the implementer subagent records the parent session's model, because a Claude Code subagent inherits CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID and its own entries are not in that log at all; verified from inside the reviewer subagent, and confirmed here by 15,631 log entries of which none carries isSidechain true. With shadow off the gate would refuse a slice that ran exactly as routed. F2: the delivery line that prices the delivered kpi.json is unguarded. F3: no handoff follows the last slice, so every ticket under-reports it. F4: a return to solution leaves the committed copies on the old plan's model and doctor reports drift. F5: record 46's failure reason quotes a figure check 40 does not contain, one record after note 42 corrected the same fault. F6: reopen leaves the receipt in place, so a reopened ticket falls back on a detached HEAD.
